finalText:
I've moved all 13 passengers from the cancelled AA918 onto new flights, issued the vouchers they're owed and sent each of them one message with their new itinerary. Nobody was charged a change fee or fare difference, and no refunds were needed.

**Something to check:** the system date is 2026-10-05, but AA918 was due to fly on 2026-08-03, two months ago. You asked for this re-protection and the system accepted every change, so I went ahead. Someone should still confirm it wasn't meant to happen before the travel date.

**How I ordered passengers:** there are no bulletins in effect, so the standard rules applied. I went by tier (platinum, then gold, then silver, then none), then by earliest booking date. Each passenger got the soonest arrival still open in their own cabin.

| Order | Reservation | Passenger (tier) | New itinerary | Late by | Vouchers |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | R6103 | Chloe Park (Platinum), business | UA88, 3 Aug, 06:15 to 12:25 | arrives early | none |
| 2 | R6109 | Iris Vance (Platinum), economy | UA88, 3 Aug, in premium economy (upgrade) | arrives early | none |
| 3 | R6110 + R6111 | Jun Takeda / Kofi Mensah (group G-7, ranked as Gold), economy | AA204, 3 Aug, 09:05 to 15:15, together | 1h35 | none |
| 4 | R6102 | Ben Okafor (Gold), economy | DL512, 3 Aug, 12:30 to 18:40 | 5h00 | $150 compensation |
| 5 | R6106 | Farid Haddad (Gold), basic economy | UA88, 3 Aug | arrives early | none |
| 6 | R6112 | Lea Sorensen (Gold), premium economy | AA204, 3 Aug, in business (upgrade) | 1h35 | none |
| 7 | R6104 | Dev Mehta (Silver), economy, to Boston | AA210, 3 Aug, 17:40 to 23:50, then AA1410, 4 Aug, 09:00 to 12:25 Boston | 17h30 | $300 compensation + $180 hotel |
| 8 | R6113 | Mo Farah (Silver), economy, to Boston | same as Dev | 17h30 | $300 compensation + $180 hotel |
| 9 | R6108 | Hugo Brandt (Silver), economy | AA210, 3 Aug, 17:40 to 23:50 | 10h10 | $300 compensation |
| 10 | R6107 | Grace Liu (no tier), economy | AA206, 4 Aug, 09:05 to 15:15 | 25h35 | $240 compensation (capped at her $240 fare) + $180 hotel |
| 11 | R6101 | Ana Ruiz (no tier), economy | AA206, 4 Aug | 25h35 | $300 compensation + $180 hotel |
| 12 | R6105 | Elena Fox (no tier), basic economy | AA204, 3 Aug, 09:05 to 15:15 | 1h35 | none |

- **Upgrades:** only Iris and Lea moved up, each by one cabin. Each is Gold or Platinum, travelling alone on a single flight. Their own cabin was full on a flight that arrives sooner than anything still open in that cabin.
- **No upgrade for Ben:** he qualifies by tier, but premium economy was already full on both earlier flights, so he stayed in economy.
- **Group G-7:** Jun and Kofi stayed together in economy, with no upgrade.
- **Boston connections:** Dev and Mo could no longer make their original AA1402 connection, so both legs were rebooked. The overnight connection on the morning of 4 Aug counts as valid.
- **Hotel vouchers:** these went to the four passengers who now arrive a day later than planned: Dev, Mo, Grace and Ana.
